Angela — thanks, quick tech notes ahead of the 3:30pm sync: 

- Canary proposal: break into three incremental phases (alpha, beta, broad):
  * Alpha (internal): smoke tests + KV-warmup against 10% traffic on quantized v2 model variant.
  * Beta (early customers): 25% traffic with prefix caching enabled and dedicated routing to avoid cold-starts.
  * Broad: 100% traffic with automated fallback to hosted small-model tier if latency > 600ms p50 for two consecutive 10-minute windows.
- Acceptance telemetry: token throughput, p50/p95 latency, error rate (>0.5% triggers rollback), and model hallucination signal from our eval harness (we’ll share a short eval suite).
- Rollback: immediate traffic cut to previously pinned model + alerting chain (PagerDuty escalation to Eng on-call) — documented in canary-checklist.csv (attached).
- Migration: we will run a dry-run migration in staging 48 hours before the first alpha night to validate KV dump/load and prefix caches.

I’ve attached a lightweight canary-checklist.csv stub (steps and owner columns); we’ll flesh it on the call and push the canonical version to the Confluence runbook.
